_comment: Bundled Clearly MCP connectors: `clearly` = production (relay.clearly.sh), `clearly-staging` = staging worker. Install the plugin → both servers + the skills, one step. OAuth, no token: /mcp -> pick a server -> Authenticate. (Claude Code namespaces plugin-bundled servers, so /mcp lists them as `plugin:clearly:clearly` / `plugin:clearly:clearly-staging` — the server names are `clearly` / `clearly-staging`.)
